statements.words: jajñāte tanayau pṛśneḥ śvaphalkaś citrakas tathā
jajñāte tanayau pṛśneḥ śvaphalkaś citrakas tathā
tasyāṃ jajñe tadā vīraḥ śrutavān iti bhārata akrūro
akrūreṇaugrasenyāṃ tu sugātryāṃ kurunandana sudevaś copadevaś ca jajñāte
citrakasyābhavan putrāḥ pṛthur vipṛthur eva ca
ariṣṭanemes tu sutā dharmo dharmabhṛd eva ca
